title: Pregnancy-Wise Leakage-Controlled Multi-Representation Fusion for Classifying Early- and Later-Recorded Electrohysterographic Recordings Using Wavelet Scalograms
description: Version 1.1.1 adds original, record-identified outer-fold assignments for 126 ICEHG records; complete pregnancy-disjoint fit, early-stopping, and untouched evaluation roles for all 15 nested inner folds; and final outer-model fit/early-stop assignments. These identifiers were cross-checked against the originally saved fold audits and held-out record-level predictions (126/126 agreement, zero pregnancy overlap). The reference PyWavelets requirement is pinned to 1.8.0, and the historical v1.1.0 pip-freeze discrepancy is documented rather than erased. The authoritative CLEAN v3.1 Colab notebook, aggregate outputs and all reported model results are unchanged. This study concerns early/later EHG recording-period classification, not clinical preterm birth prediction; ICEHG source signals and large derivatives are not redistributed.
